title: Daily Range Puzzle
user: Friends who want a free, browser-based daily puzzle with a small cooperative tactical layer rather than another solitary word game.
smallest_useful_product: Static daily seeded hex-board puzzle with fixed map scale, one cooperative link, keyboard/touch controls, and a spoiler-safe results card.
constraints: Use deterministic public seeds with no personal data; make color-independent terrain markers; avoid copyrighted game rules and names; provide offline replay of prior days.
